name: polymend
description: Make 3D models ready to print: repair the mesh faults slicers warn about, set the print height, and get an STL and a 3MF of each model.

interface.longDescription: Reviews a 3D model, repairs the small mesh faults that make a slicer complain (stray triangles, pinholes, reversed faces, split seams), stands it on the bed at the height you ask for, and writes an STL and a 3MF. Shows the model from four sides with every change marked, compares it with the reference pictures, and says what came out well and what did not. Works on GLB and STL files or links, up to 20 at once. Runs on your own computer in the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex (Node.js 20 or later); Polymend uploads nothing.
defaultPrompt: Make this GLB ready to 3D print.
Repair these models for printing and give me STL and 3MF files.
Turn the 3D model you just made into a print-ready STL.

publication.release_notes: Local GLB/STL mesh repair, optional print sizing, STL/3MF export, annotated previews, and reference-image review.
